summary.text: James Townsend is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2025, representing District 34 in Eddy and Otero counties.
The legislature's member page lists Townsend as a representative from 2015 to 2024, and as ranking member of the Senate Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Townsend's occupation as retired director of Holly Energy and a district office in Alamogordo.
Townsend also sits on the Senate Judiciary Committee and, between sessions, on the Courts, Corrections and Justice Committee and the Water and Natural Resources Committee.
